title: ServiceSpec
description: Specification of the desired behavior of a Service, defining port mappings, pod selection, service type, IP configuration, and traffic policy.

type.description: How the Service is exposed. ClusterIP (default) creates an internal IP; NodePort adds a node-level port; LoadBalancer provisions a cloud load balancer; ExternalName maps to an external DNS name.

selector.description: Label selector identifying the Pods this Service routes traffic to. Not used for ExternalName services.

ports.description: List of port mappings for this Service.

clusterIP.description: Cluster-internal IP address for the Service. Assigned automatically unless explicitly set. Set to 'None' for headless services.

clusterIPs.description: List of cluster IPs for dual-stack services. The first value is the primary clusterIP.

ipFamilies.description: IP families used by this Service for dual-stack configuration.

ipFamilyPolicy.description: IP family policy for dual-stack configuration.

externalName.description: External DNS name this Service resolves to. Only used when type is ExternalName. No proxying or load balancing is performed.

externalIPs.description: Additional IPs for which nodes will also accept traffic for this Service. Not managed by Kubernetes.

externalTrafficPolicy.description: How external traffic is routed. Local preserves client source IP but may be unbalanced; Cluster routes to any ready pod.

sessionAffinity.description: Session affinity type. ClientIP routes repeated requests from the same IP to the same pod. Defaults to None.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds of idle time before the session affinity timeout elapses.

loadBalancerIP.description: Specific IP to request for the load balancer when supported by the cloud provider.

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: CIDR ranges allowed to access the load balancer. Traffic outside these ranges is dropped by the load balancer.

healthCheckNodePort.description: Health check node port when externalTrafficPolicy is Local and type is LoadBalancer.

publishNotReadyAddresses.description: If true, the DNS will provide the addresses of not-ready endpoints for this service. Defaults to false.

allocateLoadBalancerNodePorts.description: Whether NodePorts are allocated for LoadBalancer services. Set to false to disable NodePort allocation. Defaults to true.
